entries.name: Tags
entries.description: (Optional) An array of pairs of the form [ tagNum1 tagText1 … tagNumn tagTextn ] where each tagNum is an integer representing a TIFF tag number and each tagText is an ASCII string representing the corresponding ASCII tag value.

title: Entries in a version 2.0 OPI dictionary

entries.name: Type
entries.description: (Optional) The type of PDF object that this dictionary describes; if present, shall be OPI for an OPI dictionary.

entries.name: Version
entries.description: (Required) The version of OPI to which this dictionary refers; shall be the number 2 or 2.0 (not the name 2.0, as in an OPI version dictionary).

entries.name: F
entries.description: (Required) The external file containing the low- resolution proxy image.

entries.name: MainImage
entries.description: (Optional) The pathname of the file containing the full-resolution image corresponding to this proxy, or any other identifying string that uniquely identifies the full-resolution image.

entries.name: Tags
entries.description: (Optional) An array of pairs of the form [ tagNum1 tagText1 … tagNumn tagTextn ] where each tagNum is an integer representing a TIFF tag number and each tagText is an ASCII string or an array of ASCII strings representing the corresponding ASCII tag value.

entries.name: Size
entries.description: (Optional) An array of two numbers of the form [ width height ] specifying the dimensions of the image in pixels.

entries.name: CropRect
entries.description: (Optional) An array of four numbers of the form [ left top right bottom ] specifying the portion of the image to be used. The Size and CropRect entries shall either both be present or both be absent. If present, they shall satisfy the conditions 0 ≤ left < right ≤ width and 0 ≤ top < bottom ≤ height In this coordinate space, the positive y axis extends vertically downward; hence, the requirement that top < bottom.

entries.name: Overprint
entries.description: (Optional) A flag specifying whether the image is to overprint (true) or knock out (false) underlying marks on other separations. Default value: false.

entries.name: Inks
entries.description: (Optional) A name object or array specifying the colorants to be applied to the image. The value may be the name full_color or registration or an array of the form [ /monochrome name1 tint1 … namen tintn ] where each name is a string representing the name of a colorant and each tint is a real number in the range 0.0 to 1.0 specifying the concentration of that colorant to be applied.

entries.name: IncludedImageDimensions
entries.description: (Optional) An array of two integers of the form [ pixelsWide pixelsHigh ] specifying the dimensions of the included image in pixels.

entries.name: IncludedImageQuality
entries.description: (Optional) A number indicating the quality of the included image. Valid values are 1, 2, and 3.

title: Entries in the linearization parameter dictionary

entries.name: Linearized
entries.description: (Required) A version identification for the linearized format.

entries.name: L
entries.description: (Required) The length of the entire file in bytes. It shall be exactly equal to the actual length of the PDF file. A mismatch indicates that the file is not linearized and shall be treated as ordinary PDF, ignoring linearization information. (If the mismatch resulted from appending an update, the linearization information may still be correct but requires validation; see G.7, "Accessing an Updated File" for details.)

entries.name: H
entries.description: (Required) An array of two or four integers, [ offset length ] or 1 1 [ offset length offset length ]. offset shall be the offset of the 1 1 2 2 1 primary hint stream from the beginning of the file. (This is the beginning of the stream object, not the beginning of the stream data.) length shall be the length of this stream, including stream object 1 overhead. If the value of the primary hint stream dictionary’s Length entry is an indirect reference, the object it refers to shall immediately follow the stream object, and length also shall include the length of the indirect 1 length object, including object overhead. If there is an overflow hint stream, offset and length shall specify its 2 2 offset and length.

entries.name: O
entries.description: (Required) The object number of the first page’s page object.

entries.name: E
entries.description: (Required) The offset of the end of the first page (the end of EXAMPLE 6 in F.3.1, "General"), relative to the beginning of the file.

entries.name: N
entries.description: (Required) The number of pages in the document.

entries.name: T
entries.description: (Required) In documents that use standard main cross-reference tables (including hybrid-reference files; see 7.5.8.4, "Compatibility with Applications That Do Not Support Compressed Reference Streams"), this entry shall represent the offset of the white-space character preceding the first entry of the main cross-reference table (the entry for object number 0), relative to the beginning of the file. Note that this differs from the Prev entry in the first-page trailer, which gives the location of the xref line that precedes the table. (PDF 1.5) Documents that use cross-reference streams exclusively (see 7.5.8, "Cross-Reference Streams"), this entry shall represent the offset of the main cross-reference stream object.

entries.name: P
entries.description: (Optional) The page number of the first page; see F.3.4, "First-Page Cross-Reference Table and Trailer (Part 3)". Default value: 0.
